decisions.reason: After two years without any website presence, this peripheral consumer product appears to have yielded enough negative information that its option value is low and resources are better redeployed to the firm's core industrial technologies and newer ventures.

Even though the modular extensions fit the core business, their disappearance from the firm's visible offer for two years suggests the standalone line did not justify continued market support relative to other engineering options in the portfolio.

As a core waste-to-energy flagship, it still retains option value because industrial plant commercialization can be slow and the firm is more likely to keep a strategically central technology alive unless evidence against it becomes clearer than the website alone shows.

Despite its strategic proximity to the established offer, two years of non-observation indicate that commercialization uncertainty has likely resolved unfavorably enough that the firm would reallocate effort toward stronger waste-to-energy opportunities.
